verdict.rationale: The skills ship as SKILL.md folders, and the vendor states they work across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. Install routes exist for several vendors' tooling: Claude, Codex and Copilot plugin marketplaces plus the vendor-neutral `npx skills` installer. That supports the portability outcome of the story, but nothing in the evidence says the skills conform to the open Agent Skills specification. missing for 10: explicit statement of Agent Skills spec conformance, documentation of the frontmatter/folder format against the spec, independent or hands-on verification that the same folder validates in non-Claude tools.
